description: This file contains test cases for the Telegram update offset store module, verifying read, write, and delete operations, handling of edge cases, and ensuring correct behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: deleteTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Deletes the stored Telegram update offset for a specific account, ensuring only the targeted account is affected.

methods.name: readTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Reads the stored Telegram update offset for a specific account, verifying token matches and handling legacy data.

methods.name: writeTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Stores the update offset for a specific Telegram account, with validation for the update ID.

methods.name: withStateDirEnv
methods.description: Sets up an environment with a designated state directory for testing, providing a temporary environment for file operations.
